summary.text: Roger DeGroot is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 7 who assumed office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former educator, he served as superintendent of the Brookings School District.

paragraphs.text: Roger DeGroot's career experience includes working as an educator, and he served as superintendent of the Brookings School District.
DeGroot assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Education Committee and the House Local Government Committee.
